results.title: Embed and theme parameters
results.checks: ?embed=minimal hides the sidebar and toolbars; ?theme=dark applies the dark theme

results.title: The chat panel
results.checks: The host starts a session; the bar gains Chat, which opens the old reader's chat panel listing Session chat and Study companion. A guest joins: the host's chat says 'Flow guest joined'. The guest types @ and picks the host from the list, adds 'see John 3:16': the host sees 'Flow guest is typing...', then the line with their @name marked and John 3:16 as a link, which opens John 3 with verse 16 chosen. With the chat closed, '@everyone hello' puts @ on the host's Chat button; opening the chat clears it
results.note: Chat listed Session chat and Study companion; the join, typing, the @mention, the John 3:16 link and the @ badge all worked

results.title: Show everyone, the roster, chat, the record
results.checks: Host starts a session (a record is kept in the Library; its path on hover); a guest joins; the guest selects 3:16 and the host's roster says so; the host shows everyone 3:9 and the guest sees the ribbon; a chat line from the guest reaches the host
results.note: record kept; roster shows the guest at verse 16; the guest saw verse 9 shown; chat reached the host (code FH45HD)

results.title: The old reader's bottom bar; every action within reach
results.checks: On a desktop the bar is ‹ Books · Search · Discover · the extensions · More ›, each with its word under the icon; Books opens the book picker and Search opens the floating search box, ready to type in; More lists Sign in, Live session, Today, Notes, Library, Your content, Full screen and Themes. On a phone every one of those actions is in its five tabs (Today · You · Bible · Search · More) or the More sheet
results.note: desktop bar: Books · Search · Discover · Places map · Study companion · More; under More: login Sign in, group_add Live session, today Today, sticky_note_2 Notes, queue_music Library, library_books Your content, fullscreen Full screen, dark_mode Themes; Books and Search open; on a phone all 9 actions reachable

results.title: A phone: the old reader's phone shell
results.checks: On an iPhone 13: a thin bar at the top (the translation, then ☆, bookmark, share and text settings), the chapter's title centred and large (John over a big 3), and along the bottom play and the chapter pill ‹ John 3 › above the five tabs Today · You · Bible · Search · More, with Bible lit. The pill's › goes to John 4 and its label opens the book picker; Bible on the text opens it too. More → Tabs opens the Tabs drawer, which closes with its ✕ and with a tap beside it; reading down scrolls the page itself; signed out, You carries the count of changes waiting and opens the sign-in pane
results.note: top bar: 5 buttons; title "John 3"; tabs Today · You · Bible · Search · More; › and the pill and Bible worked; the Tabs drawer closed by ✕ and by a tap beside it; the page scrolled; You carried the waiting count and opened sign-in

results.title: The old reader's page links
results.checks: /en/about opens About; ?today=open opens Today; ?search=open opens the floating search; ?chatFirst=true puts Chat first on the desktop bar outside a live session, and on a phone makes Chat the fourth tab with Search under More
results.note: /en/about → About; ?today=open → Today; ?search=open → search; desktop: Books · Search · Chat · Discover; phone: Today · You · Bible · Chat · More, Search under More
